hints.title: Boolean Indicator Array
hints.text: Replace each element nums[i] with 1 if nums[i] % modulo == k, and 0 otherwise.

hints.title: Prefix Remainder Condition
hints.text: A subarray from index l to r is interesting if (pref[r] - pref[l]) % modulo == k.

hints.title: Hash Map Modulo Lookup
hints.text: Rewrite as pref[l] % modulo == (pref[r] - k + modulo) % modulo. Use a counter to record frequencies of prefix sums modulo the divisor.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def countInterestingSubarrays(self, nums: List[int], modulo: int, k: int) -> int:
        counts = Counter({0: 1})
        curr = 0
        ans = 0
        for x in nums:
            if x % modulo == k:
                curr = (curr + 1) % modulo
            target = (curr - k + modulo) % modulo
            ans += counts[target]
            counts[curr] += 1
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Single pass using remainder hash map.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n^2) nested loop over all subarrays times out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(min(n, modulo)) hash map tracking prefix sum frequencies.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Map to prefix sum remainders and look up matching prefixes.
